errors.text: The intervention is stated only as generic machine learning and molecular dynamics, omitting the decisive replacement of EAM by an MTP and thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation.
The hypothesis does not identify the TaVCrW BCC refractory alloy or the relevant DFT, pressure, temperature, supercell, and exchange-correlation conditions.
The proposed mechanism omits rapid FEP convergence from the low-variance MTP–DFT energy difference, as well as electronic and short-range-order contributions to melting.
No quantitative predictions are provided for computational savings, free-energy agreement, melting-point shifts, or solid-state stabilization.

The cited evidence concerns processing, mechanical, tribological, or magnetic properties and does not support machine-learned interatomic potentials, free-energy calculations, or fusion thermodynamics.
The falsification criterion uses undefined 'significant' deviations and therefore is not decisively testable.
